slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost (purchases + repairs) over all stages, with no other terms such as a penalty for having more tools than required?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and confirmed it is minimizing total tool cost.

slot_scores.name: mandatory_repair_after_each_stage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a tool is sent for repair at the end of stage j, does it have to be one of the tools that was available (and counted toward r_j) during stage j, or could a tool that is already in repair be re-sent for another repair?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on repair eligibility and later asked about wear/breakdown, but did not explicitly ask whether all tools used in a stage must be sent for repair at the end of that stage.

slot_scores.name: fast_repair_return_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you send a tool for fast repair at the end of stage j, is it available at the start of stage j + q (i.e., one stage later when q = 1), or at the start of stage j + q + 1?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the exact return timing for fast-repaired tools.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, and the P1 mandatory-repair rule was not fully resolved.

summary: The agent recovered the core objective and fast-repair timing, but only partially addressed the mandatory repair rule and never reached a final modeling state; the interaction also became repetitive on payment-timing questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
